# Timeline

Activity feed / event log: dots (status colours) or icons, title, relative time, description and optional content.

`KenosUI.Timeline` · Data display

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Timeline title={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Timeline" title="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

| `status` | `"online" \| "offline" \| "degraded" \| "maintenance" \| "unknown" \| "stopped" \| "running" \| "frozen" \| "error" \| "starting" \| "stopping" \| "primary" \| "accent" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "error" \| "neutral"` |  |
| `icon` | `IconName \| React.ReactNode` |  |
